newsitem.title: GERMANY: Austria's Edlinger - policies must secure firm euro.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Edlinger - policies must secure firm euro.

text.p: Austrian Finance Minister Rudolf Edlinger urged on Tuesday that European nations conduct exchange rate policies designed to ensure a stable and strong euro once monetary union begins at the end of the decade.

"During the early stage of the currency union, the exchange rate policy will need to demand a strong euro, so that the necessary trust in the new currency will be created among investors and consumers as well as corporations," Edlinger said in a prepared speech for an international conference.
In the longer term, Edlinger said, "it will be essential that international exchange rate policies will be geared to ensure growth and employment in all major economic regions."
The key goal should be that euro exchange rates should be stable as compared with the dollar and the yen, Edlinger added at the Global 24 European Monetary Union conference.
